summary: ElevenLabs Startup Grants give early-stage startups up to 12 months of free access to the full ElevenLabs platform at the Scale tier, capped at 33,000,000 characters total — advertised as over 680 hours of Agents usage and $5,500+ in value, not a monthly allocation. Covers Agents, Voice Design, Voice Cloning, Speech, Sound Effects, Music, and Image & Video. Eligibility: monetized product use case, valid business email, fewer than 25 employees, long-term product intent, no agencies/consultancies or SMBs, no projects for children aged 18 or under, one application per company, existing enterprise customers excluded. Rolling applications; decisions within one week. Unless you select otherwise, the plan automatically converts to Free after the grant term or once 10,000 credits remain; the FAQ also states Free conversion if the 33M-character cap is exhausted early.
claim_steps: Apply at https://elevenlabs.io/grants-application with a valid business email and monetization strategy.

Eligibility: <25 employees, long-term monetized product use case; agencies, consultancies, SMBs, projects for children aged 18 or under and existing enterprise customers are excluded. One application per company.
Decision within one week; accepted grants receive up to 12 months of platform access, capped at 33M characters total, not per month.

Monitor remaining credits: unless you select otherwise, the plan converts to Free after the term or once 10,000 credits remain; the FAQ also specifies conversion if the 33M-character cap is exhausted early.
